thread:
jess: FYI AxiomWave flagged rising monthly spend and a few 'entity formatting' regressions in finance intents on /chat. renewal in ~6w. marker: health = yellow. thinking a targeted performance play: intent routing + compact model for FAQs + opt-in int8, keep summarize on high-precision. open to alternate ideas.
ryan-ml: quick telemetry dive: top intents by QPS -> FAQ/short-answers 68%, policy/summarize 14%, others 18%. cost concentrated on FAQ due to high QPS. tail p95 spikes during business hours. we should separate hot path (faq) from cold heavy-context paths.
priya-se: agree. proposal:
- route intent:faq to a compact quantized candidate (redwood/mini-qa-v1-int8)
- keep prod FP model for intent:summarize and intent:report
- enable per-prefix KV caching for repeated questions
- phased canary: 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 72h with metric gates
sam: pulled customer feedback: "faster but sometimes drops $TICKER formatting". they want an objective check on entity preservation before upgrading traffic. also asked about rollback safety.
ryan-ml: validation plan: assemble a 500-sample eval set from recent customer traffic (anonymized) focusing on entity cases. metrics: entity-F1, answer-recall, latency_p95, and cost per 1k tokens. success gates: entity-F1 within 1.0% absolute of prod, latency_p95 improvement >=15%. fallback: auto-switch to FP if entity-F1 drops >1.2% in any rolling 60m window.
priya-se: routing snippet (pseudo):
```yaml
routes:
  - match: "intent:faq"
    model: "redwood/mini-qa-v1-int8"
    weight: 0.03
  - match: "intent:summarize"
    model: "redwood/prod-ppx-4.0"
    weight: 0.97
rollout:
  phases: ["30m","6h","24h","72h"]
  metrics_gate: "entity_f1 >= prod - 0.01 AND latency_p95_improve >= 0.15"
```
jess: good. what's the ballpark cost delta if faq path moves to compact-int8?
ryan-ml: estimate: token cost down ~35% on faq traffic; overall monthly spend down ~18% given distribution. latency p95 for faq expected down 25-40%. quantization alone adds ~8-12% extra savings but watch small accuracy delta (~0.5%).
sam: passing plan to AxiomWave for sign-off on eval set + rollback bounds. they prefer a short-run user A/B of visible formatting for some key flows before full cutover.
ops-bot: created ticket CS-1833 "AxiomWave precision/economy routing pilot" assigned to @ryan-ml,@priya-se,@jess due 2026-02-02. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-1833 :white_check_mark:
priya-se: I'll draft the canary script and route rule. ryan, can you prepare the anonymized eval set and run baseline vs mini-qa-int8? please include entity-F1 and sample counterexamples.
ryan-ml: on it. `./run_eval --model redwood/mini-qa-v1-int8 --dataset axiomwave_entity_eval.json --metrics entity_f1,latency_p95,cost`
jess: thanks — once we have initial numbers we'll update the renewal playbook and outreach language. keep the thread updated. :thumbsup:
